name: Recent Bookmarks Search Bot
tagline: Makes the posts you saved on X searchable in a plain sortable table
description: Saving something on X takes a second and finding it again weeks later does not. Connect your account and it pulls your hundred most recent saves into a grid you can order by author, by date or by how the post performed, open any row for the full thing, and extend further down when your quota permits.
author: Sriram
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
